purpose: Pre-method learnability gate for the latent-capability teaming candidate; this is not a method comparison.

g1_gate.learnable: At least 2/3 seeds exceed the frozen random-reference mean completed-food count by 0.25 foods per episode.
g1_gate.not_saturated: Mean endpoint completion is below 1.90 foods per episode or mean cooperative-high-food completion is below 0.95.
g1_gate.stop_rule: If either condition fails, stop C1 before posterior-method design; do not tune rewards, horizons, or budgets.

boundaries: The actor receives its own level and public positions/food state, never a teammate's true level.
The critic may receive full simulator state during training only; all future arms use the identical critic information.
This gate establishes only task learnability and non-saturation. It does not establish posterior inference, novelty, or a method effect.
